items.title: Upgrading and troubleshooting Amazon MWAA with AWS agent skills
items.summary: AWS publishes MWAA agent skills in the open source AWS agent toolkit: procedures your AI coding assistant can run to upgrade Amazon MWAA from Airflow 2.x to 3.x and troubleshoot failures, with a safety confirmation on every environment change.
items.creator: Kamen Sharlandjiev
categories: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)
